name: Project Sail (Prologis data center campus, Coweta County)
aliases: Prologis Coweta County data center campus
summary: Proposed hyperscale data center campus on roughly 830 acres in rural Sargent, about 7 miles northwest of Newnan in Coweta County, Georgia, near Georgia Power's Plant Yates. Atlas Development originally proposed the project, disclosed in early 2025 as a 13-building plan reported at USD 17 billion; Prologis took over development and cut the plan to nine buildings with about 4.34 million square feet. Trade press estimates the campus could need about 900 MW; Chattahoochee Riverkeeper, an environmental group, puts peak demand at full build-out at 910 MW. Coweta County approved the rezoning 3-2 in April 2026 after a moratorium and sustained local opposition.

location.note: Coordinates are the Wikipedia centroid of Sargent (s5). The river group's fact sheet (s1) places the site in rural Sargent about 7 miles northwest of Newnan, with Wahoo Creek crossing the property; no parcel coordinates were found.

parties.name: Atlas Development LLC
parties.note: Original applicant for the rezoning. In June 2025 Prologis was reported to be set to buy the site from Atlas, with the deal not yet closed; later sources describe Prologis as the developer.

parties.name: Georgia Power
parties.note: Prologis says Georgia Power has confirmed it can serve the campus.

parties.name: Coweta County
parties.note: Approved the rezoning by a 3-2 vote; county staff had found it inconsistent with the comprehensive plan.

metrics.note: Trade press estimate of the campus's continuous power demand, first reported for the 13-building plan in 2025 and repeated at the April 2026 rezoning; neither source says whether it is IT or total load. Chattahoochee Riverkeeper's fact sheet (s1), an environmental group's figure, puts whole-campus demand at peak operation and full build-out at 910 MW. Prologis's project site gives no capacity.
Reported as the potential value of the campus, first for the 13-building plan in 2025 and again at the April 2026 rezoning. No investment figure appears on the Prologis project site.
Reduced from 13 buildings in the plan reported in 2025.
Prologis says total floor area fell by 12% from the earlier plan, which trade press in 2025 put at nearly 5 million square feet.

milestones.note: The river group says the project was first disclosed in early 2025 and lists Atlanta press coverage of the proposal dated 3 January 2025.
Coweta County imposed a 180-day moratorium on data center rezonings and permits while it rewrote its rules, holding up the application.
Coweta County approved the rezoning 3-2, as reported on 9 April 2026; county staff had found it inconsistent with the comprehensive plan.

power_sources.description: Georgia Power supply; Prologis says the utility has confirmed capacity. The site lies near Georgia Power's Plant Yates, which trade press cites as a factor in choosing the land.

notes: No report after the April 2026 rezoning of a closed land purchase or construction start was found. Prologis's project site is undated; it describes closed-loop air cooling without evaporative cooling, up to about 300,000 gallons of water a day at peak, and a tax estimate that assumes full build-out in 10 years. The 910 MW figure is Chattahoochee Riverkeeper's, an environmental group, not Prologis's; the metric uses the trade press estimate of about 900 MW instead.
